notes.title: OUR NEXT GAME IS OUT NEXT WEEK!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33432372/be21cf24a8543abe4574dad1e54e237d6abaa498.gif[/img]

Hey STONE fans and players,

The next game from Convict Games, BURN is out next Friday August 9th on Steam here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1534660/BURN/

Nina BURN is the biggest pop star in the world.

Will you change pop music? Start a cult? Become a monster?

YOU decide and you will BURN 🔥

BURN is our next story and it is our most interactive so far where your dialogue change her dialogue, the soundtrack and results in an ending from 16 endings. We also focused BURN to be purely an interactive story, so your only interactive is through choosing your dialogue choices. We keep the vibe of STONE and added lots of impacts on the story for you to discover and decipher Nina's story. So BURN is not 3D but rather a series of high quality animations with voice-over that adjust based on your choices across the game.

So what you're seeing in the trailer is how the games looks!

Our art is done by, Francois our amazing artist / animator on BURN :)

Another special thing about BURN is you don’t ever hear the music Nina creates and the world worships. Instead BURN features a composed soundtrack of multiple genres by Joonas Turner creator of Tormentor X Punisher and audio from Broforce, Noita, Nuclear Throne and more. Joonas is an awesome member of the team.

Genres include Dark ambient, Techno, Black Metal, Berlin post-wave, Russian sci-fi ambience and Hip Hop that scores your story. It's very special and you'll love it. We can't wait to share more and this is just the beginning.

WISHLIST NOW

It's another Convict Games story and tackles a new setup and character to study.

Hope you enjoy it and wishlist it ahead to stay tuned!

GREG LOUDEN
CONVICT GAMES

notes.title: The Universim devs are donating their next two months of revenue to aid Australian bushfire relief
notes.content:
Crytivo, the developers behind simulation god game, The Universim, have announced they’ll be donating their profits to those affected by the wildfires sweeping across Australia.

In a community update on Steam titled “Mission Koala”, the US-based developers have pledged to give 100% of their profits from their own store, along with 30% of profits from all their Steam sales during January and February to help the fire relief effort.

notes.title: Play a koala PI in hip-hop stoner noir Stone, out now
notes.content:
A washed-up private investigator koala is searching for his kidnapped girlfriend boyfriend [the koala himself tells me -ed.] in Stone, a new “hip-hop stoner noir” story-o-adventure game released today. What’s hip-hop stoner noir when it’s at home? Well, the koala looks not wholly unlike The Dude out The Big Lebowski, so there’s a big hint. Off you go, exploring an open-world town, chatting to the animalfolks, and getting your deadbeat arse into a whole lot of trouble. It also seems a good opportunity to brush up on the sort of Australian slang you won’t learn from Neighbours or Home And Away.

(more…)
